textwithimage.text:
Based on TQMx70EB Intel® Core™ (7th Generation) 7000E series Kaby Lake-H

The Embedded Starterkit STKx70EB is an evaluation kit designed for high-end computing and graphics capabilities. It is based on the TQMx70EB platform, featuring Intel® Core™ (7th Generation) 7000E series processors (Kaby Lake-H). This kit supports Intel® Optane™ 3D XPoint SSDs and provides large bandwidth with up to 24 PCIe lanes (Gen 3), including a PCIe x16 PEG port. It also includes the TQMx86 board controller with custom expansion options, a watchdog, thermal management, and energy-efficient ECO-Off mode. The kit offers optimized graphics performance with Intel® Iris™ Pro 630, supporting hardware-accelerated 10-bit HEVC and VP9 encoding/decoding. Suitable for demanding applications in the medical, gaming, and industrial sectors.

text.text:
Features

  • Intel® Core™ (7th Generation) Processors: Equipped with 7th Gen Intel® Core™ i7/i5/i3 and Intel® Xeon® E3-15xx v6 processors (Kaby Lake-H) for high-performance computing.
  • Intel® Optane™ Support: Enables the use of Intel® Optane™ 3D XPoint SSDs for fast and efficient storage.
  • High PCIe Bandwidth: Supports up to 24 PCIe lanes (Gen 3), including a PCIe x16 PEG port for high-speed data transfer.
  • Graphics Performance: Offers optimized graphics performance with Intel® Iris™ Pro 630, capable of three independent display outputs at up to 4K resolution.
  • Power Efficiency: Incorporates power and performance optimization technologies like Intel® Turbo Boost Technology 2.0 and Enhanced Intel® SpeedStep Technology for efficient operations.
